versions.content: If the trigger transmit API is enabled for the hardware object, Can_Write() shall interpret a null pointer as SDU (Can_PduType.Can_SduPtrType = NULL) as request for using the trigger transmit interface. If so and the hardware object is free, Can_Write() shall call CanIf_TriggerTransmit() with the maximum size of the message buffer to acquire the PDU’s data.
